mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_model_metric (model_name, prediction_type, aggregate_period, period_start, rmse, mae, accuracy, latency_p50, latency_p95, latency_p99, sample_count, drift_detected) VALUES (#{modelName}, #{predictionType}, #{aggregatePeriod}, #{periodStart}, #{rmse}, #{mae}, #{accuracy}, #{latencyP50}, #{latencyP95}, #{latencyP99}, #{sampleCount}, #{driftDetected}) ON CONFLICT (model_name, prediction_type, aggregate_period, period_start) DO UPDATE SET rmse = EXCLUDED.rmse, mae = EXCLUDED.mae, accuracy = EXCLUDED.accuracy, latency_p50 = EXCLUDED.latency_p50, latency_p95 = EXCLUDED.latency_p95, latency_p99 = EXCLUDED.latency_p99, sample_count = EXCLUDED.sample_count, drift_detected = EXCLUDED.drift_detected
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_model_metric WHERE drift_detected = true ORDER BY created_at DESC
